verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 is hardware, but it ships with an official software and developer ecosystem (CUDA Toolkit, SDKs, developer portal). An official MCP server for GPU management, telemetry or docs is therefore plausible, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows NVIDIA offers one. The llms.txt file is not an MCP server, and claims about running agents locally describe compute capacity, not agent connectivity.
